    • resolve

      @Internal public static Optional<URL> resolve(List<ResourceLoader> loaders, String path, @Nullable String indexPage)
      Resolves the path of a resource, relative to the base of the resource loaders, to a URL: the first loader that has the resource provides it. An empty path is the index page, and a path without an extension that no loader has, e.g. a directory, is tried with the index page under it.
      Parameters:
      loaders - The resource loaders, tried in order
      path - The path of the resource, relative to the base of the loaders
      indexPage - The name of the index page, or null for none
      Returns:
      The URL of the resource, if a loader has it
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • resolveResource

    • resolveResource

      @Internal public static Optional<StaticResourceResolver.ResolvedResource> resolveResource(List<ResourceLoader> loaders, String path, @Nullable String indexPage, Predicate<? super StaticResourceResolver.ResolvedResource> acceptable)
      Resolves the path of a resource like resolveResource(List, String, String), taking only the resources a predicate accepts: a resource it refuses, e.g. another spelling of the path on a file system that ignores the case, is a miss, and the next location is tried.
      Parameters:
      loaders - The resource loaders, tried in order
      path - The path of the resource, relative to the base of the loaders
      indexPage - The name of the index page, or null for none
      acceptable - Whether a resource of a loader is the resource
      Returns:
      The resource, if a loader has one the predicate accepts
      Since:
      5.3.0
